notes:
Prospect: Amberfort National Labs (multi-lab gov research org). Very strict air-gap/on-prem requirement — CISO: "No cloud egress, no persistent external connections; update media only via controlled handoff." Looking for a Private Redwood deployment (air-gapped), HSM/KMS integrations, and deterministic audit logs with redactable traces for classified workflows. Primary use: secure research assistant + embeddings-based search across declassified and controlled datasets. Interested in model pinning + offline model update workflow (USB/secure courier).

Meeting highlights: POC scope agreed in principle: 6-week phased POC. Phase 1 ingest ~2TB declassified corpora (read-only) and validate embeddings/search latency. Phase 2 deploy secure chat assistant with policy filters and hallucination guard rails. Phase 3 offline model update + DR/failover test in isolated rack.

Quote from CISO on 2026-02-19 demo call: "We need zero outbound network surface by default. Any management/control plane must be inside our network or controlled with a private link and audited handoff."

Infrastructure notes: will provide isolated VLANs, FIPS HSM appliances, and SIEM integration (syslog/CEF). Expect procurement to request export-control and IL5-style contractual language. SE to run architecture deep-dive with Amberfort infra (on-site) week of 2026-03-22.

Decision drivers: security (HSM, air-gap), deterministic auditability, offline update process, operator support SLA (onsite/reserved capacity), and clear pricing for one-off offline model refreshes. Cost sensitivity: medium (mission critical) — willing to pay premium for validated air-gapped solution but wants predictable ARR banding.

Next steps: send updated SOW + security appendix; schedule on-site integration workshop; start HSM integration test plan.
